voice: Composed, morbidly intrigued, and observant while redirecting Laura toward Yvette and Ernie.

entries.text: Miss Bow, this is a private office.
Oh! I was only looking around. Have you seen this paper cutter? There appears to be blood on the blade.

Oh, that is not blood. You gave me quite a thrill. It is probably red ink. If you're looking for Yvette, I saw her heading down to Ernie's office in the basement. She spends a great deal of time there.
Yvette is fond of everyone, my dear. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have business to attend to.
